page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/activity-brief.md` for the full workflow. Pull Azure Boards work items strictly by `AssignedTo` and GitHub commits/PRs strictly by `author` for the given person and date range, build a labeled evidence/inference trail, then synthesize a leadership-ready outcomes brief that names no individual and omits low-level implementation detail. Verify every completion claim (merged/closed) against the live PR or work item state before writing it — search-index snapshots go stale, so re-fetch each cited PR's live state rather than trusting the snapshot. This confirms the PR's own state only; it does not establish any artifact's governance status — read that artifact's declared `status:` frontmatter field directly if governance status must be stated. Do not use "ratified" for any artifact. Optionally generate a matching 1-slide deck via `/presenter` when `--slide` is passed.
